priceSnapshot.note: The morning report printed 78,316.0 at 06:59:41 COT and left a REDUCE gate at a settled 1H close below 77,950.0 and an ADD gate at a settled close above 78,800.0. The REDUCE gate FIRED AND WAS WRONG - see calibration. Sequence since: the 12:00Z hour opened 78,314.1, sold to 77,700.0 and closed 77,934.0, below the gate; the 13:00Z hour closed 77,863.8, so the no-reclaim clause confirmed it. Then the 14:00Z hour reversed the entire thing, closing 78,600.0, and price has held higher ever since - 78,588.5, 78,636.5 and a live 17:00Z bar that has tagged 79,000.0. Spot is 78,862.6, up 546.6 points and 0.70 percent on the morning read and 1,162.6 points off the session low. The 24h open is 79,073.4, so the day is still fractionally red at -0.27 percent despite the intraday recovery; 24h high 79,181.8, 24h low 77,000.0. sessionRange below covers 12:00Z forward, the window this report is responsible for.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 78,200.0 and no reclaim on the next bar. LOWERED from 77,950.0 - which sounds backwards until you read the level it is now anchored to. The 1H EMA20, EMA50 and EMA100 have compressed into a 21.6-point knot at 78,304.0 / 78,303.8 / 78,325.6, the tightest they have been all month, and price has spent the last four hours above it. 78,200.0 sits just under that knot and under the 78,209.7 low of the 15:00Z bar. It is 662.6 points beneath spot, which is 1.31 hourly ATRs, and that width is DELIBERATE: the 77,950.0 gate the morning report set was 366 points wide, roughly 0.82 ATRs, it fired on a 234-point overshoot and cost 1,066 points of upside. This desk has now logged eight separate whipsaws inside the 0.4-to-0.6 ATR band. A gate that sits outside it and under a genuine EMA cluster is worth more than a gate that is close enough to feel responsive.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 79,000.0. RAISED from 78,800.0, which has now been pierced twice intraday without a settled close and has stopped carrying information. 79,000.0 is the session high, it is the round number, and it is the last remaining short-liquidation bucket ABOVE spot at 540,341 USD. Clearing it on a close means the advance has eaten the final overhead cluster and 79,181.8, then the 79,401.4 high from yesterday, open up with almost nothing between them.

decisionBox.changed: BOTH GATES MOVE AGAIN, and the honest headline of this report is that the morning's REDUCE gate fired and lost money. The stance stays ADD - the ledger took a second small spot tranche - but the reasoning has changed shape. What earns the continued bullish tilt is the QUALITY of the recovery, not its size. Open interest is 2,147,628,887.67 USD, DOWN 0.41 percent from the morning's 2,156,530,567.77, while price is UP 0.70 percent: this is a deleveraging advance, driven by shorts covering and spot bid, not by new leverage being added. The OKX retail long/short account ratio is 1.10, its lowest reading of the entire move, down from 1.12 at the morning report and 1.15 at midnight - retail has been selling into every leg of this rally. Funding is 0.0000644647411382 per 8h, a nominal 0.00645 percent, DOWN from the morning's 0.00765, and the perpetual premium is still NEGATIVE at -0.0004588603784204 with mark 78,828.3 sitting 34.3 points UNDER spot. A perp trading at a discount while price makes session highs is the cleanest available evidence that the bid is coming from spot buyers, not levered longs. Every EMA on every timeframe is now beneath price. Against that, three things keep this at 'range' rather than 'bullish': daily RSI is 69.05 and pressing overbought, falling open interest means the squeeze has less fuel left than it did this morning, and the macro tape is unfriendly - Brent 90.31 up 2.51 percent, US10Y up 3.6bp to 4.758 percent, and QQQ, VOO and JPXN all red intraday.

calibration.rollingRecord: Twenty-four sessions logged. The 0.4-to-0.6 ATR band tally now reads: four clean confirmations, two whipsaws, one gate that whipsawed then confirmed on the second trigger, one that triggered twice and was voided both times, one report whose ADD and REDUCE both fired nine hours apart, one window in which BOTH gates were pierced intraday and NEITHER confirmed on a close, one ADD gate that confirmed properly on two consecutive settled closes and still lost money, and now - this run - a REDUCE gate that confirmed properly under its own two-bar clause and cost 1,066 points of upside. That is two consecutive sessions in which the confirmation machinery worked exactly as specified and the resulting trade lost. The rule is not the problem; the width is.
calibration.note: THE RESULT THAT MATTERS. The morning file's REDUCE gate was a settled 1H close below 77,950.0 with no reclaim on the next bar. It FIRED and it CONFIRMED: the 12:00Z hour closed 77,934.0, 16 points under the trigger after a 77,700.0 spike low, and the 13:00Z hour closed 77,863.8, so the no-reclaim clause was satisfied unambiguously. Anyone who reduced on that confirmation sold at roughly 77,864 and watched price close the 14:00Z hour at 78,600.0 and tag 79,000.0 four hours later - 1,066 points and 1.37 percent of missed upside. actingHelped is FALSE and priorReduceFired is TRUE. The morning report deserves credit for naming this risk in advance: it wrote that the raised gate sat 366 points beneath spot, 'roughly 0.82 hourly ATRs, which is inside the whipsaw band this log has been documenting all week,' and added the one-bar reclaim clause specifically to absorb it. The clause was not enough, because the reclaim took two bars rather than one. The correction applied in this report is structural, not cosmetic: the new reduce gate at 78,200.0 is 662.6 points and 1.31 hourly ATRs beneath spot and is anchored under a real 1H EMA cluster rather than under a fresh higher low. The morning's ADD gate at 78,800.0 has NOT fired on a settled close - the 16:00Z hour closed 78,636.5 - although the live 17:00Z bar has traded through it to 79,000.0, so it may yet resolve inside the endday window; it is logged as add_fired false as of this report and the gate has been retired in favour of 79,000.0. One backfill was applied to calibration.json: the 2026-08-31 morning row gets price_next_report 78,862.6, reduce_fired corrected from its placeholder to TRUE and acting_helped set to false.
